1 · Intro

When to use it.

Almost every HCM task starts the same way: open Our Workforce, pick a quick action, and search for the person.

Before you change anything, read the Employment Info page so you know the person's current assignment and recent history.

Use this whenYou need to look up a person or start any transaction for someone in your area.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Do not start a transaction until you have confirmed the right person and the right assignment.
  • What you can see and do is controlled by your security role; a missing quick action usually means a role issue, not a system error.
  • Open item: confirm how HCMs view a record as of a past or future date on the Redwood Employment Info page at Vanderbilt.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Start Here

Quick Actions and Viewing Person and Employment Information

Use when: You need to look up a person or start any transaction for someone in your area. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. From the Oracle Home page, open Our Workforce.
  2. Click Show More to see every quick action.
  3. Open Employment Info and search for the person.
    • Use person number when names are similar.
  4. Read the assignment details.
  5. Review the history of changes.
  6. Check future-dated changes before you submit anything new.

Watch-outs

  • Do not start a transaction until you have confirmed the right person and the right assignment.
  • What you can see and do is controlled by your security role; a missing quick action usually means a role issue, not a system error.
  • Open item: confirm how HCMs view a record as of a past or future date on the Redwood Employment Info page at Vanderbilt.
